blurb: Pale porcelain washed by four blurred pools — blush, lilac, peach, and mint — under film grain, with milky frost cards, airy bold type, and pill actions. A separate night field is near-black with one warm amber-to-mauve glow. Not colorless night glass, not clay, not chrome.

tagline.en: Soaked color, milky frost, a grain of film
tagline.zh: 色晕渗开，乳白磨砂，一层细颗粒
